scripts.translation: 看来上级已经允许你进入了，那我也不会阻拦你。

scripts.text: By the way, hmm... Can you understand what I'm saying?

真不敢相信我们居然能互相理解！

scripts.text: When did you learn our language?
scripts.translation: 你什么时候学会我们的语言的？

scripts.text: - I show my ring to Arc and explain everything including how I ended up here... -
scripts.translation: - 我向阿克展示戒指，并把事情经过告诉了他，包括我是如何来到这里的...... -
原来如此......嗯，事情是这样的......

scripts.text: The source of that huge shock and mysterious explosion...
scripts.translation: 那个巨大冲击和神秘爆炸的源头......

scripts.text: That's why you humans were exploring here and there...
scripts.translation: 原来你们人类一直在到处探索...

scripts.text: Now I clearly understand that you are not sent by the giants of Manuk.
scripts.translation: 现在我明白了，你不是马努克巨人派来的。

scripts.text: Thank you for telling me these interesting stories.
scripts.translation: 谢谢你告诉我这些有趣的事。

scripts.text: We use different languages as expected...
scripts.translation: 看来我们果然使用不同的语言......

scripts.text: I might mispronunce it, so please understand...
scripts.translation: 我可能会念错，请多包涵......

scripts.text: Anyways, I have a favor to ask you. Is it okay?
scripts.translation: 总之，我有件事想拜托你。可以吗？

scripts.text: - Arc looks around to check if someone else is around. Satisfied you're alone he continues with his story in a low tone. -
scripts.translation: - 阿克环顾四周，确认附近没人后，才压低声音继续说。 -

scripts.text: Frankly, I'm worried about a friend of mine who left without permission saying that she's going to check on your camp. She hasn't come back since then.
scripts.translation: 老实说，我很担心一个朋友。她未经许可就离开了，说要去查看你们的营地。从那以后她就没回来。

scripts.text: But, I can't leave this post to look for her 'cause I have a duty to guard the research data stored here.
scripts.translation: 可是我不能擅离岗位去找她，因为我有责任守护存放在这里的研究资料。

scripts.text: Since she left without permission, I can't even report to my superiors... that will just end up as a bigger problem.
scripts.translation: 她未经许可就离开了，我甚至没法向上级报告......那只会让事情变得更糟。

scripts.text: The thought of it just worries me...
As a matter of fact, we are trying not to have any contact with the giants of Manuk so we stay away from each other's territory.
scripts.translation: 事实上，我们尽量避免和马努克巨人接触，所以彼此都不进入对方的领地。

scripts.text: That camp of yours is located in the area that has been acting as the neutral zone between our two races...
scripts.translation: 你们的营地位于我们两族之间的中立地带......

scripts.text: If she has gotten close to their side then she might have gone over to the snow fields...
scripts.translation: 如果她已经靠近他们的领地，可能去了雪原......

scripts.text: That will make it even more difficult for us to look for her...
scripts.translation: 那样我们就更难找到她了......

scripts.text: The Manuk giants might misunderstand this as provoking them...Couldn't they?
scripts.translation: 马努克巨人可能会把这当成挑衅......不是吗？

scripts.text: So...the point is, you want me to look for your friend. Right?
scripts.translation: 所以，你是想让我去找你的朋友，对吧？

scripts.text: Because you can't do it yourself from all these complicated situations?
scripts.translation: 局势这么复杂，你自己没法离开岗位去找她？

scripts.text: But, I'm going to need more information if I'm going to look for her.
scripts.translation: 不过，要找她的话，我需要更多线索。

scripts.text: You don't have to worry about that...
^4d4dffTerra^000000 has a habit of making a knot out of plants to mark her destination.
scripts.translation: ^4d4dff泰拉^000000习惯用打结的植物标记自己走过的地方。

scripts.text: She does it so that she won't get lost.
scripts.translation: 她这样做是为了防止迷路。

scripts.text: If you find a trail of knotted plants it should lead you to where she is.
scripts.translation: 如果你发现一串打结的植物，顺着它们应该就能找到她。

scripts.text: It can be hard to look for them, but it's better than doing nothing...
scripts.translation: 找起来可能很困难，但总比什么都不做强......

scripts.text: Ah, and please keep this a secret from the other Laphines.
scripts.translation: 还有，请对其他拉斐族保密。

scripts.text: Remember {0}... you must keep this to yourself...
It sure was an unreasonable favor...
You too were sent here to carry on a mission...
scripts.translation: 你也有自己的任务要执行......

scripts.text: You were sent here to carry on your own mission...
scripts.translation: 你也有自己的任务要执行......

scripts.text: ^4d4dffTerra^000000 has a habit of making a knot out of plants to mark her destination.
scripts.translation: ^4d4dff泰拉^000000习惯用植物打结来标记去过的地方。

scripts.text: Keep that in mind when searching for her. And don't tell any other Laphine's about her missing.
scripts.translation: 寻找她时请留意这一点。还有，别告诉其他拉斐族她失踪了。

scripts.text: You {0} are the only one I could ask for help...
Have you found any knotted plants?

scripts.translation: 那就是泰拉留下的标记。

scripts.text: Keep it up and find her
- Arc looks like he was thrown into confusion about something. -
scripts.translation: - 阿克看起来有些不知所措。 -

scripts.text: but, she was covered all over with wounds...
scripts.translation: 她平安回来了！可是她浑身是伤......

scripts.text: She just took the Bradium with that exhausted body!
scripts.translation: 就拖着疲惫的身体把布拉迪姆带走了！

scripts.text: Didn't even tell me the reason!
I told her no, but she wouldn't listen to me!
scripts.translation: 我明明拦着她，可她根本不听！

scripts.text: It happened all of a sudden.
What do I have to do?
Terra left again and she was hurt...
scripts.translation: 泰拉又离开了，而且她受了伤......

scripts.text: And I just stood here...doing nothing.
scripts.translation: 而我只是站在这里......什么也没做。

scripts.text: You have a strong sense of responsibility.
I couldn't either stop her, or follow her...
scripts.translation: 我既没能拦住她，也没能跟上她......

scripts.text: Why did she take the Bradium...?
scripts.translation: 她为什么要拿走布拉迪姆......？

scripts.text: - You tell Arc about the Giant from the cave. -
scripts.translation: - 你把洞穴里那名巨人的事告诉了阿克。 -

scripts.text: Bradium...is certainly a precious ore for Sapha.
scripts.translation: 布拉迪姆确实是萨法族珍视的矿石。

scripts.text: They use a refined Bradium ore...
scripts.translation: 他们会使用精炼过的布拉迪姆......

scripts.text: You said that a Sapha was hurt?
scripts.translation: 你说有个萨法族受伤了？

scripts.text: And its body was already stiff?
- Arc suddenly began gathering up his gear. -
scripts.translation: - 阿克突然开始收拾装备。 -

scripts.text: Where was that cave where you found that Sapha?
scripts.translation: 你发现那名萨法族的洞穴在哪里？

scripts.text: There was no such cave when we inspected our surrounding areas.
scripts.translation: 我们巡查周边时，根本没见过这样的洞穴。

scripts.text: What are you trying to do?
I'm going out to look for Terra. She took the Bradium with her, it has got to be something to do with that Sapha.
scripts.translation: 我要出去找泰拉。她带走了布拉迪姆，这肯定和那名萨法族有关。

scripts.text: Is it okay for you to leave your post?
Shit, then what should I do!!
I will go. I'm the one who knows exactly where that cave is.
scripts.translation: 我去吧。只有我知道那个洞穴的确切位置。

scripts.text: I will go and bring her back.
If Terra headed for that cave, I should be able to find her.
scripts.translation: 如果泰拉去了那个洞穴，我应该能找到她。

scripts.text: Let's hear rest of the story from Terra.
scripts.translation: 我们先听泰拉把事情说完吧。

scripts.text: It is important for you to guard this place, isn't it?
scripts.translation: 你得留在这里守卫，对吧？

scripts.text: If Terra really took the Bradium without any permission...
scripts.translation: 如果泰拉真的未经许可就拿走了布拉迪姆......

scripts.text: The higher ups won't just remain still...
I'm sorry to ask you but...
Please go and bring her back here...
I'm really sorry for getting you into this mess.....
scripts.translation: 真的很抱歉把你卷进这堆麻烦里......

scripts.text: What? A wounded Laphine in the Sapha's village?
scripts.translation: 什么？萨法村庄里有一位受伤的拉斐族？

scripts.text: Was it Terra?! Was she captured by those Sapha bastards?!
scripts.translation: 是泰拉吗？！她被那些萨法族抓住了吗？！

scripts.text: Calm down. I couldn't check out exactly who the captured Laphine was.
scripts.translation: 冷静点。我没法确认被抓的拉斐族是不是泰拉。

scripts.text: And they seem to have no intention of harming the Laphine.
scripts.translation: 而且他们似乎没有伤害她的意思。

scripts.text: Also, they were looking for something that can cure a wounded Laphine...
scripts.translation: 另外，他们在找能治疗受伤拉斐族的东西......

scripts.text: If we bring some medicine to them, we might have a chance to see who the Laphine is.
scripts.translation: 如果我们给他们带些药，也许有机会确认她是谁。

scripts.text: I understand how anxious you feel.. but that is the only way I can think of finding out who it is.
scripts.translation: 我明白你有多着急......但这是我唯一能想到的确认她身份的办法。

scripts.text: I will take some things to treat the wounds with me and if it turns out that the captured Laphine is Terra, I will bring her back.
scripts.translation: 我会带些疗伤药过去。如果被抓的拉斐族是泰拉，我就把她带回来。

scripts.text: OK, that seems like the best thing we can do for this situation...
scripts.translation: ..好吧，看来这是目前我们能做的最好的事了......

scripts.text: Do you by any chance know about the 'Yggdrasil'?
There's nothing better than the Yggdrasilberry to treat wounds...
scripts.translation: 没有什么比世界树果实更适合治疗伤口......
尤其对我们拉斐族而言......

scripts.text: If you have a Yggdrasilberry, you can use it to cure that Laphine...
scripts.translation: 如果你有世界树果实，就可以用它治疗那位拉斐族......

scripts.text: .Yggdrasil is the tree of life... its roots are in touch with everything in this world.
scripts.translation: 世界树是生命之树，它的根系与世间万物相连。

scripts.text: I will give you these but they won't be enough...
scripts.translation: 我把这些给你，但数量还不够......

scripts.text: Outside... there is a huge tree... where the root of the Yggdrasil is exposed.... it should be there.
scripts.translation: 外面有一棵巨树，世界树的根在那里露出地面......果实应该就在附近。

scripts.text: Sometimes you can find Yggdrasilberries around there.
scripts.translation: 有时能在那附近找到世界树果实。

scripts.text: Go find few more and bring them with you. Hurry!
scripts.translation: 再去找几颗带上。快去吧！

scripts.text: There's a huge root of the tree near a swamp at the outskirts of this area.
scripts.translation: 这片区域边缘的沼泽附近有一根巨大的树根。

scripts.text: That's where the tree of life's root is exposed.
scripts.translation: 生命之树的根就在那儿露出地面。

scripts.text: You should be able to find some Yggdrasilberries there.
scripts.translation: 你应该能在那里找到一些世界树果实。

scripts.text: You will need at least 6~7 of them...
As soon as you are done collecting the berries, bring them to the Sapha Village right away!!!
scripts.translation: 采到果实后，立刻把它们带到萨法村庄！！！

scripts.text: She is back in one piece!
...She hasn't been saying a single word since her return, I told her to rest in Yai...
scripts.translation: ......她回来后一直一言不发，我让她去雅伊休息了......

scripts.text: Please come by if you don't mind...
Which is her Private Residence... It's located at the Southeast direction from here.
scripts.translation: ...泰拉的雅伊（她的私人住处）在这里的东南方。

scripts.text: I would like to hear a detailed account of what happened.
scripts.translation: 我想听听事情的详细经过。
她离开期间......到底发生了什么？

scripts.text: I would like to hear a detailed account fn what happened...
scripts.translation: 我想听听事情的详细经过......

scripts.text: Please go to Terra's Yai later.
I really appreciate what you've done for us.
scripts.translation: 我真的很感激你为我们所做的一切。

scripts.text: I hope she can be her old self...
scripts.translation: 希望她能恢复从前的样子......

scripts.text: This area is off-limits to unauthorized personnel.
scripts.translation: 此区域禁止未经授权的人员进入。

scripts.text: - I can't understand what he's saying... Oh god how frustrating. -
scripts.translation: - 我听不懂他在说什么......天哪，真让人沮丧。 -

scripts.text: - We don't seem to understand eachother. -
scripts.translation: - 看来我们彼此都听不懂对方的话。 -

scripts.text: This area is restricted unless you have been given permission.

尤其是像你这样的外来者。

scripts.text: - Looks like we don't understand each other. This could be troublesome... -
scripts.translation: - 看来我们彼此都听不懂对方的话。这下麻烦了...... -

scripts.translation: 我真不知道她哪来的胆子，竟敢直接飞进我们的领地。

scripts.translation: 那个妖精一直喊着“布拉迪姆！布拉迪姆！”

scripts.translation: 村里的巡逻队说，那个妖精受到布拉迪姆的力量影响，发疯了。

scripts.translation: 她们只想用这种作为我们生命之源的矿石做饰品。

scripts.translation: 凡是有魔力的东西，她们都收集。

scripts.translation: 奥根失踪后不久，那个妖精就出现了......实在可疑......

scripts.translation: 可是，那种叫布拉迪姆的矿石真有那么强的魔力吗？

scripts.text: Really? But, we Sapha can't live without bradium.
scripts.translation: 真的吗？可我们萨法族离不开布拉迪姆。

scripts.translation: 我们与拉斐族开战......就是为了保护布拉迪姆不被她们夺走......

scripts.text: Your people and their people are fighting over the bradium...

scripts.translation: 那你如何看待这种局势？

scripts.translation: 我带了个能翻译妖精语言的人来！

scripts.translation: 闭嘴！总之，我们还有很多事要担心。这个拉斐族得先治伤......

scripts.text: Her body is completely different from ours. What should we do?
scripts.translation: 她的身体和我们完全不同。该怎么办？

scripts.text: Hey, Snorren! Bring me anything. Anything like herbs!
scripts.translation: 嘿，斯诺伦！给我拿点东西来，什么草药之类的！

scripts.translation: 草药？她情况这么严重吗？

scripts.text: Can't we fix her with bradium?

scripts.translation: 我真不觉得奥根做得对......

scripts.text: What if this is an evil plot by them?
scripts.translation: 这会不会是他们设下的阴谋？

We've been fighting them for a long time.
We don't have any reason to trust what you or they are saying.
scripts.translation: 我们没理由相信你们或他们的话。

scripts.text: And talking about some cave that doesn't even exist.

scripts.text: That cave really exists, I swear!
scripts.translation: 那个洞穴确实存在，我发誓！

scripts.text: I.. yeah. I saw a petrified Sapha in that cave.
scripts.translation: 我...对，我亲眼在洞穴里看到了石化的萨法。

scripts.text: I will bring back something that will make you believe.

scripts.text: I'm not sure if that Sapha is this Ogen you are looking for...

scripts.translation: 泰拉，这位就是救了你的人...

scripts.translation: 泰拉在你们营地附近徘徊时，发现了当时也在附近徘徊的一名萨法。

scripts.translation: 他们都小心翼翼地避开你们人类，却还是撞见了彼此，于是打了起来。

scripts.text: And then they eventually fell into that hole in the swamp and ended up in that cave.
scripts.translation: 后来他们掉进沼泽里的一个洞，最后落入了那个洞穴。

scripts.text: Yeah... We were both unconscious for some time..
scripts.translation: 是的...我们昏迷了一阵子...

scripts.text: And by the time we were able to wake up and see... We were surrounded.
scripts.translation: 醒来时才发现...周围全是敌人。

scripts.text: Our main concern was getting out of there...
scripts.translation: 我们当时只想着逃出去...

scripts.text: Even though we couldn't understand each other's language... We made a temporary truce.
scripts.translation: 虽然听不懂彼此的语言...但还是暂时停战了。

scripts.text: You were outnumbered and at the last moment Ogen sacrificed himself to protect you.
scripts.translation: 你们寡不敌众，最后关头奥根为了保护你，牺牲了自己。

I was just trying to repay him...
Repaying one's dept is a good thing.

scripts.translation: 对骄傲的拉斐族来说，尤其如此。

scripts.text: First is, You went away without permission...
scripts.translation: 第一，你未经允许就擅自离开...

scripts.text: If something like that happened... of course I would help...

scripts.text: I won't act foolish ever again.

scripts.text: I will put in a good word to the superiors...

scripts.text: I'm sorry this is all I can give you for now.

scripts.text: Arc... I will get some rest...

scripts.translation: 我们拉斐族原本非常不愿让外人进入领地...

scripts.text: Terra's still not fully recovered yet, so keep that in mind.

scripts.text: How did you guys get here?
scripts.translation: 你们是怎么到这里来的？

scripts.text: Your language seems gentle, but it seems like you are here to create more tension.
scripts.translation: 你们说话听起来挺温和，可看起来像是来加剧紧张局势的。

scripts.text: Yes, we humans are smaller than you... but...
scripts.translation: 没错，我们人类比你们矮小...但是...

scripts.text: we have been training ourselves to be strong.
scripts.translation: 我们一直在锻炼自己，让自己变得更强。

scripts.text: Now let me show you that

I will find you a worthy challenge to prove it.
scripts.translation: 我会给你安排一个够格的挑战，来证明你的实力。

scripts.text: Yes, but human beings can be stronger when they all work together.
scripts.translation: 是的，但人类团结合作时会更加强大。

scripts.text: From the Bradium we can extract a special element that we need to survive.
scripts.translation: 我们能从中提取生存所需的一种特殊成分。

scripts.text: The mining industry is primary here since our lives depend on it.
scripts.translation: 我们的生活离不开布拉迪姆，因此采矿至关重要。

scripts.text: I don't have a name to tell you!
scripts.translation: 我没法告诉你我的名字！

scripts.text: If you are so bored, why don't you go fishing?
scripts.translation: 这么无聊的话，为什么不去钓鱼？

scripts.text: Ah~ I've heard from our Commander about you. You've done much for the Midgard Alliance Camp. Anyways, what brings you here?
scripts.translation: 啊~我听指挥官提起过你。你为米德加尔特联盟营地做了很多事。对了，你来这里有什么事？

scripts.text: I thought I had confused you a bit...
scripts.translation: 我还以为能让你困惑一下呢...

scripts.text: Confusion is a feeling that comes from distraction of one's mind when something that couldn't be predicted happens. I'm not a person who easily gets confused.
scripts.translation: 所谓困惑，就是发生意料之外的事时，思绪受到干扰而产生的感觉。我可不是那么容易困惑的人。

scripts.text: I'm a linguist from Arunafeltz. I'm a scholor who studies a system and a structure of every kinds of language in the world.
scripts.translation: 我是来自阿鲁纳菲兹的语学家，研究世上各种语言的体系和结构。

scripts.text: And...don't you think the reason man like me is here is that there's a predictable cause?
scripts.translation: 而且...你不觉得我会出现在这里，必然有其原因吗？

scripts.text: From what I heard, you've done much for the Midgard Alliance Research Group.
scripts.translation: 据我所知，你为米德加尔特联盟研究组做了很多事。

scripts.text: And while you were helping us, I believe you've seen and visited many places here in the other world.
scripts.translation: 在帮助我们的过程中，你应该也游历过异世界的许多地方。

scripts.text: Have you met the other world's people by any chance?
scripts.translation: 你有没有遇到过异世界的居民？

scripts.text: Looks like you haven't encountered them yet.
Rumor here says that there's a fairy-looking and a giant wood people living out in the fields next to our camp here.
scripts.translation: 听说营地旁的原野上住着像妖精一样的族群，以及高大的木人。

scripts.text: Apparently these people are speaking in a strange languages that we humans can't understand...but no one seems to be able to remember how their languages sound like.
scripts.translation: 据说他们说着人类听不懂的奇怪语言...但似乎没人记得那些语言听起来是什么样。

scripts.text: A NEW language!! This is an exciting discovery for a linguist like myself, but as you know, there's dangerous monsters outside... It's not possible for a mere scholor to go out wandering around.
scripts.translation: 新语言！！对我这样的语学家来说，这可是令人兴奋的发现。但外面有危险的魔物...普通学者不可能独自出去闲逛。

scripts.text: I've said this much, I think you'd be able to guess what I'm going to ask you to do.
scripts.translation: 我说到这里，你应该能猜到我要拜托你做什么了吧。

scripts.text: The Alliance Research Group has great interest in other intelligent life. Each country's secret agents are making every effort to communicate with those two races, there's just not enough information.

scripts.text: Do me a favor and go outside of the camp, find the fairies and wooden giants, and remember everything that they are saying, word for word so that I can hear what their language sounds like.
scripts.translation: 帮我个忙，去营地外找妖精和木巨人，把他们说的话一字不漏地记下来，让我听听他们的语言。

scripts.text: It's a wonder that at the moment when I heard that language first-hand I could decode it flawlessly in spite of myself. It must be the blessing of Goddess Freya.
